title: Ignition Lockout
shortDescription: Raypak heater failed to ignite after three tries and has locked out.
fullDescription:
Error 1100 on Raypak Digital and VERSA series heaters indicates the control failed to prove flame after three ignition attempts. The heater locks out until power is cycled or the ignition lockout is manually reset from the keypad.

Low gas pressure, a dirty flame rod, or a weak spark from the ignitor are most common. Propane users should verify the tank is not low — even 20% can cause flame-proving issues on a cold day.

causes.cause: Low gas pressure or empty propane

fixSteps.title: Clear lockout
fixSteps.instruction: Press Menu then select Clear Ignition Lockout, or cycle breaker 60 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Clean flame rod
fixSteps.instruction: Remove flame rod, polish with fine sandpaper, reinstall.

whenToCallPro: Gas valve replacement and combustion tuning need a licensed tech.

faq.a: Three — after the third fail the heater locks out.

title: Flame Sense Failure
shortDescription: Flame was lit but the control could not sense it, so safety shutdown occurred.
fullDescription:
Error 1124 means the burner briefly lit but the flame sensing circuit did not detect ionization current above threshold. The control closes the gas valve and retries.

Flame rod insulator cracks, ground continuity issues, and soot on the rod are the typical causes. Polarity on the incoming 120VAC is also relevant — if hot and neutral are swapped, ionization may not read.
symptoms: Heater lights then shuts off in 5 seconds

fixSteps.title: Clean flame rod
fixSteps.instruction: Remove, polish, reinstall; check insulator for cracks.

whenToCallPro: Polarity or ground issues need an electrician.

faq.a: Raypak wants >1.5 μA at the sensor.

title: Vent Pressure Switch Open
shortDescription: The exhaust vent pressure switch did not close, combustion cannot proceed safely.
fullDescription:
Error 1141 indicates the vent (draft) pressure switch has not closed when the blower is running. Raypak requires positive proof of draft before opening the gas valve.

Obstructed vents, disconnected pressure tubing, excessive vent length, or a tripped-over-backdraft condition will trigger this code.
symptoms: Blower runs continuously then heater aborts

fixSteps.title: Inspect vent
fixSteps.instruction: Visually check vent cap and piping for obstruction.

whenToCallPro: Vent redesign requires a licensed gas tech per NFPA 54.

faq.a: Raypak specifies this in the install manual — usually 20-50 feet depending on diameter.

title: Low Water Flow
shortDescription: Heater's water pressure switch is open — insufficient flow detected.
fullDescription:
Error 1156 is Raypak's low water flow fault. The heater needs a minimum water flow (typically 30 GPM on residential sizes) before the gas valve opens.

Any condition reducing flow — dirty filter, clogged basket, low pump speed, closed valves — can cause it. Chronic 1156 sometimes indicates a worn-out pump impeller.
symptoms: Heater won't fire while pump runs

fixSteps.title: Restore flow
fixSteps.instruction: Clean baskets, backwash/rinse filter, raise pump speed to 2800+ RPM for heating.

whenToCallPro: If flow is verified, pro can bench-test the switch.

faq.a: Yes, heat mode should prioritize flow over efficiency — use 2800-3200 RPM on VS pumps.

title: High Limit Switch Trip
shortDescription: Heater tripped the high-limit safety due to excessive exchanger temperature.
fullDescription:
Error 1167 means one of the high-limit switches has opened. Raypak uses 135°F limits that open if water at the exchanger gets too hot, either from low flow or scaled tubes.

After cooldown, the limit resets automatically but the code persists until cleared. Recurring 1167 requires exchanger descale or flow diagnosis.

fixSteps.title: Restore flow
fixSteps.instruction: Clean baskets, filter, and raise pump speed.

whenToCallPro: Acid flush of exchanger requires PPE and a pro.

faq.a: Yes — the switch recloses at ~105°F, but the code must be cleared manually.

title: Blower Speed Fault
shortDescription: Combustion blower is not running at the commanded speed.
fullDescription:
The VERSA and Avia series have a variable-speed combustion blower with RPM feedback. Error 1134 appears when actual RPM differs from target by more than the allowed window.

A failing blower motor, blocked intake, or tachometer wire issue will trigger it.

fixSteps.title: Inspect blower
fixSteps.instruction: Check intake and blower wheel for debris.

whenToCallPro: Blower replacement and combustion tuning — pro required.

faq.a: Typically blue — consult wiring diagram inside door.

title: Water Temperature Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Inlet or outlet water thermistor reading is out of range.
fullDescription:
Error 1104 on Raypak digital heaters indicates the water temperature thermistor (inlet or outlet) is open or shorted. Without accurate water temperature, the heater cannot modulate.

Corroded contact pins, broken lead wires, or a failed sensor element are common. Part replacement is a 30-45 minute job.

fixSteps.title: Test sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug sensor, measure ohms (~10kΩ at 77°F). Replace if infinite or zero.

whenToCallPro: Leaking sensor port requires pro resealing.

faq.a: Display usually shows which one; check service manual for pin assignments.

title: Stack High Limit
shortDescription: Exhaust stack temperature exceeded safe limit.
fullDescription:
Error 1128 indicates the flue stack temperature sensor read above the safe threshold (usually 250°F-350°F depending on model). This protects the vent piping from heat damage.

Scaled exchanger, over-firing, or a miscalibrated gas valve are typical culprits. Frequent 1128 usually means exchanger needs descaling.

causes.cause: Over-firing due to high gas pressure

symptoms: Heater shuts off during long runs

fixSteps.title: Verify flow
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure 30+ GPM through heater and no bypass issues.

whenToCallPro: Combustion analysis and descale — pro required.

title: Internal Communication Error
shortDescription: Control board lost communication with display or subordinate board.
fullDescription:
Error 2103 on Raypak VERSA heaters appears when the main control and display board cannot communicate. A loose ribbon cable or failed control board typically cause this.

Power cycling often clears transient faults. Persistent 2103 requires board-level service.

fixSteps.title: Reseat ribbon
fixSteps.instruction: Open control enclosure, reseat ribbon cable between display and main board.

faq.a: If within 2 years of install, Raypak usually covers board failures.

title: Low Gas Pressure
shortDescription: The low gas pressure switch has tripped before or during firing.
fullDescription:
Error 1144 indicates the low gas pressure switch (LGP) opened. This protects against partial combustion during a gas supply sag.

Multiple appliances starting at the same time, undersized gas lines, or propane regulator freeze-up are typical causes. Natural gas homes with added appliances often see this as a sign the gas line is too small.
symptoms: Heater drops out when dryer or furnace starts

fixSteps.title: Verify gas supply
fixSteps.instruction: Check propane level and regulator; watch for ice in cold weather.

whenToCallPro: Gas line sizing and pressure regulator work — pro only.

faq.a: Raypak needs 4-10.5" WC static at the heater inlet.
